title: Zephyr: DIO Time Option encoding/decoding
description: DIO Time Option encoding/decoding. AC: Encodes/decodes stratum and timestamp in DIO option.
close_reason: Implemented DIO Time Option encoding/decoding in rpl_messages.h and messages.c: struct lichen_rpl_dio_time with stratum and timestamp fields, lichen_rpl_dio_time_parse() and lichen_rpl_dio_time_write() functions. Wire format: Type(1)+Len(1)+Stratum(1)+Reserved(1)+Timestamp(4) = 8 bytes total.
